gtponder.ponder.chemical_reactor_ui.head: LV Chemical Reactor
gtponder.ponder.chemical_reactor_ui.text: The panel is the machine's own UI, without the player inventory.
64 grass blocks go into slot 1 and 64 glass into slot 2; the panel shows the machine's real inventory.
Fluids work the same way: tank 0 fills from 0 to 1000 mB in one second.
Covers can be put on a chosen side as well: a conveyor on top.
The model can be switched between working and idle: only the front overlay changes, the recipe logic is left alone.
